## Bridge

### deposit

`bridge.deposit`

Create bridge addresses

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.bridge.deposit({ address: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `x_builder_code` | `string` | No | Optional builder code (bytes32 hex) attributing this request to your integration so transfer issues can be traced to your app. Omitting it still succeeds but returns a `missing_builder_code` warning; a malformed code returns 400. Get your code at https://polymarket.com/settings?tab=builder |
| `address` | `string` | Yes | Ethereum address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `address` | `object \| null` | No | Bridge addresses for different blockchain networks |
| `note` | `string \| null` | No | Additional information about the bridge addresses |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="address full type">

```ts
{
  evm?: string | null,
  svm?: string | null,
  btc?: string | null,
  tron?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### quote

`bridge.quote`

Get a quote

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.bridge.quote({
	fromAmountBaseUnit: 'example',
	fromChainId: 'example',
	fromTokenAddress: 'example',
	recipientAddress: 'example',
	toChainId: 'example',
	toTokenAddress: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `fromAmountBaseUnit` | `string` | Yes | Amount of tokens to send |
| `fromChainId` | `string` | Yes | Source Chain ID |
| `fromTokenAddress` | `string` | Yes | Source token address |
| `recipientAddress` | `string` | Yes | Address of the recipient |
| `toChainId` | `string` | Yes | Destination Chain ID |
| `toTokenAddress` | `string` | Yes | Destination token address |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `estCheckoutTimeMs` | `number \| null` | No | Estimated time to complete the checkout in milliseconds |
| `estFeeBreakdown` | `object \| null` | No | Breakdown of the estimated fees |
| `estInputUsd` | `number \| null` | No | Estimated token amount received in USD |
| `estOutputUsd` | `number \| null` | No | Estimated token amount sent in USD |
| `estToTokenBaseUnit` | `string \| null` | No | Estimated token amount received |
| `quoteId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique quote id of the request |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="estFeeBreakdown full type">

```ts
{
  appFeeLabel?: string | null,
  appFeePercent?: number | null,
  appFeeUsd?: number | null,
  fillCostPercent?: number | null,
  fillCostUsd?: number | null,
  gasUsd?: number | null,
  maxSlippage?: number | null,
  minReceived?: number | null,
  swapImpact?: number | null,
  swapImpactUsd?: number | null,
  totalImpact?: number | null,
  totalImpactUsd?: number | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### status

`bridge.status`

Get transaction status

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.bridge.status({ address: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `address` | `string` | Yes | The bridge address to query for transaction status, taken from the `/deposit` or `/withdraw` response. EVM, Solana, Tron, and Bitcoin address formats are supported. EVM addresses are normalized before the request is forwarded upstream. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Maximum number of transactions per page. A page may contain fewer transactions than requested and still have a following page. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque continuation token returned as `nextCursor` by the previous response. Omit it to request the first page. URL-encode it, since cursors can contain characters such as `+`, `/`, and `=`. Invalid, tampered, or cross-address tokens return 400; restart the walk without a cursor when that happens. |
| `paginate` | `true` | No | Compatibility parameter forwarded upstream for existing integrations. Pagination applies whether or not it is sent, so new integrations should omit it and use `cursor` and `limit` alone. When sent, the only supported value is `true`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `transactions` | `object[] \| null` | No | One page of transactions for the given address, newest first. This is a page, not the full history for the address. |
| `nextCursor` | `string \| null \| null` | No | Opaque continuation token for the next page, or null when the pagination walk is complete. Pass it back verbatim as `cursor` on the next request; never parse, modify, construct, or reuse it with a different address. Stop on null rather than on an empty page or a page shorter than `limit`. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="transactions full type">

```ts
{
  fromChainId?: string | null,
  fromTokenAddress?: string | null,
  fromAmountBaseUnit?: string | null,
  toChainId?: string | null,
  toTokenAddress?: string | null,
  status?: string | null,
  txHash?: string | null,
  createdTimeMs?: number | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### withdraw

`bridge.withdraw`

Create withdrawal addresses

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.bridge.withdraw({
	address: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839',
	toChainId: 'example',
	toTokenAddress: 'example',
	recipientAddr: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `x_builder_code` | `string` | No | Optional builder code (bytes32 hex) attributing this request to your integration so transfer issues can be traced to your app. Omitting it still succeeds but returns a `missing_builder_code` warning; a malformed code returns 400. Get your code at https://polymarket.com/settings?tab=builder |
| `address` | `string` | Yes | Ethereum address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars) |
| `toChainId` | `string` | Yes | Destination chain ID (e.g., "1" for Ethereum, "8453" for Base, "1151111081099710" for Solana) |
| `toTokenAddress` | `string` | Yes | Destination token contract address |
| `recipientAddr` | `string` | Yes | Destination wallet address where funds will be sent |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `address` | `object \| null` | No | Bridge addresses for different blockchain networks |
| `note` | `string \| null` | No | Additional information about the bridge addresses |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="address full type">

```ts
{
  evm?: string | null,
  svm?: string | null,
  btc?: string | null,
  tron?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Clob

### apiKeys.create

`clob.apiKeys.create`

Create API key

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.clob.apiKeys.create({
	poly_address: 'example',
	poly_signature: 'example',
	poly_timestamp: 'example',
	poly_nonce: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `poly_address` | `string` | Yes | The wallet (EOA) address that signed the ClobAuth message. |
| `poly_signature` | `string` | Yes | The wallet's EIP-712 signature of the ClobAuth message. |
| `poly_timestamp` | `string` | Yes | The Unix timestamp (seconds) signed in the message. |
| `poly_nonce` | `string` | Yes | The nonce signed in the message (0 unless you chose another). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `apiKey` | `string \| null` | No | UUID of the API key |
| `secret` | `string \| null` | No | Base64-encoded secret key for HMAC authentication |
| `passphrase` | `string \| null` | No | Hex-encoded passphrase for secret decryption |



---

### balanceAllowance.get

`clob.balanceAllowance.get`

Get balance and allowance

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.clob.balanceAllowance.get({ asset_type: 'COLLATERAL' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `asset_type` | `COLLATERAL \| CONDITIONAL` | Yes | Type of asset |
| `token_id` | `string` | No | Token ID (asset ID). Defaults to "-1" for ERC20 collateral. |
| `signature_type` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3` | No | Signature type for address derivation (0=EOA, 1=POLY_PROXY, 2=POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE, 3=POLY_1271) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `balance` | `string \| null` | No | Balance amount in fixed-math with 6 decimals |
| `allowances` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | Map of spender addresses to allowance amounts |



---

### books.get

`clob.books.get`

Get order book

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.clob.books.get({ token_id: '21742633143463906290569050155826241533067272736897614950488156847949938836455' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `token_id` | `string` | Yes | Token ID (asset ID) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `market` | `string \| null` | No | Market condition ID |
| `asset_id` | `string \| null` | No | Token ID (asset ID) |
| `timestamp` | `string \| null` | No | Timestamp of the order book snapshot |
| `hash` | `string \| null` | No | Hash of the order book summary |
| `bids` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of bid orders (sorted by price descending) |
| `asks` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of ask orders (sorted by price ascending) |
| `min_order_size` | `string \| null` | No | Minimum order size |
| `tick_size` | `string \| null` | No | Minimum price increment (tick size) |
| `neg_risk` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether negative risk is enabled for this market |
| `last_trade_price` | `string \| null` | No | Last trade price |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="bids full type">

```ts
{
  price?: string | null,
  size?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="asks full type">

```ts
{
  price?: string | null,
  size?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### markets.get

`clob.markets.get`

Get CLOB market info

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.clob.markets.get({ condition_id: '0xdd22472e552920b8438158ea7238bfadfa4f736aa4cee91a6b86c39ead110917' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `condition_id` | `string` | Yes | The condition ID of the market |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `gst` | `string \| null \| null` | No | Game start time (used for sports markets), ISO 8601 timestamp or null |
| `r` | `object \| null` | No | Rewards configuration for a market. |
| `t` | `object[] \| null` | No | Tokens for this market |
| `mos` | `number \| null` | No | Minimum order size |

### orders.create

`clob.orders.create`

Post a new order

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.clob.orders.create({
	order: {
		maker: 'example',
		signer: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839',
		tokenId: 'example',
		makerAmount: 'example',
		takerAmount: 'example',
		side: 'BUY',
		expiration: 'example',
		timestamp: 'example',
		builder: 'example',
		signature: 'example',
		salt: 1,
		signatureType: 0,
	},
	owner: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `order` | `object` | Yes | Order payload submitted to the CLOB API. In CLOB V2, `expiration` remains in the POST /order wire body for GTD/order-expiry handling, but it is not part of the EIP-712 signed order struct. |
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | UUID of the API key owner |
| `orderType` | `GTC \| FOK \| GTD \| FAK` | No | Time in force |
| `deferExec` | `boolean` | No | Whether to defer execution |
| `postOnly` | `boolean` | No | Whether the order must rest on the book and not match immediately. Only supported for GTC and GTD orders. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="order full type">

```ts
{
  maker: string,
  signer: string,
  tokenId: string,
  makerAmount: string,
  takerAmount: string,
  side: BUY | SELL,
  expiration: string,
  timestamp: string,
  metadata?: string,
  builder: string,
  signature: string,
  salt: number,
  signatureType: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the order was successfully processed |
| `orderID` | `string \| null` | No | Unique identifier for the order (order hash) |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Status of the order after processing |
| `makingAmount` | `string \| null` | No | Amount the maker is providing in fixed-math with 6 decimals |
| `takingAmount` | `string \| null` | No | Amount the taker is providing in fixed-math with 6 decimals |
| `transactionsHashes` | `string[] \| null` | No | Array of transaction hashes (present when status is 'matched') |
| `tradeIDs` | `string[] \| null` | No | Array of trade IDs (present when status is 'matched') |
| `errorMsg` | `string \| null` | No | Error message (empty on success) |

### orders.get

`clob.orders.get`

Get single order by ID

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.clob.orders.get({ orderID: '0xabababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab' });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Order ID (order hash) |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Order status. CANCELED_MARKET_RESOLVED cancels the unfilled remainder when the market resolves; it does not undo settled fills. |
| `owner` | `string \| null` | No | UUID of the order owner |
| `maker_address` | `string \| null` | No | Ethereum address of the maker |
| `market` | `string \| null` | No | Market (condition ID) |
| `asset_id` | `string \| null` | No | Asset ID (token ID) |
| `side` | `string \| null` | No | Order side |
| `original_size` | `string \| null` | No | Original order size in shares, as a decimal string. Already normalized; do not divide by 1e6. |
| `size_matched` | `string \| null` | No | Matched size in shares, as a decimal string. Retained after cancellation; this is not the current position balance. |
| `price` | `string \| null` | No | Order price |
| `outcome` | `string \| null` | No | Market outcome (YES/NO) |
| `expiration` | `string \| null` | No | Unix timestamp when the order expires |
| `order_type` | `string \| null` | No | Order type |
| `associate_trades` | `string[] \| null` | No | Deprecated and may be omitted. Use size_matched for cumulative filled quantity, or GET /data/trades and match taker_order_id or maker_orders[].order_id to the order ID for individual fills. Absence or an empty array does not mean the order has no fills. |
| `created_at` | `number \| null` | No | Unix timestamp when the order was created |

### activity.list

`data.activity.list`

List account activity

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.data.activity.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user` | `string \| null` | No | Required; the feed is user-anchored. |
| `limit` | `number \| null` | No | Page size; default 100, max 1000, past-cap rejected. |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor`; binds the sort direction it was minted under. |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Activity type(s), comma-separated. Accepted values: `TRADE`, `SPLIT`, `MERGE`, `REDEEM` (automatic redemptions included), `CONVERSION`, `MIGRATION`, `REWARD`, `YIELD`, `MAKER_REBATE`, `TAKER_REBATE`, `REFERRAL_REWARD`, `DEPOSIT`, `WITHDRAWAL`, `DIRECTIONAL_SPLIT`, `DIRECTIONAL_MERGE`, `THRESHOLD_COMPOSE`, `THRESHOLD_DECOMPOSE`, `TIP`. Any other value is rejected with `400`. Omitted, the feed returns every type except `TIP`. `DEPOSIT` and `WITHDRAWAL` rows are returned only with `exclude_deposits_withdrawals=false`. Under its default (`true`) they are dropped even when named here, so `type=DEPOSIT` or `type=WITHDRAWAL` alone returns an empty page. `DIRECTIONAL_SPLIT`, `DIRECTIONAL_MERGE`, `THRESHOLD_COMPOSE` and `THRESHOLD_DECOMPOSE` are operations on range events, whose outcomes are value buckets and whose lines are ABOVE / BELOW positions over those buckets. A directional split turns collateral plus the buckets between two lines into ABOVE the lower line and BELOW the higher one; a directional merge reverses it. Both are rows of the whole event, so a `condition` filter never returns them. A threshold compose turns buckets into one line position and a threshold decompose turns it back; these rows carry the line's market and side. Split, merge, redeem and conversion on a range event keep `SPLIT`, `MERGE`, `REDEEM` and `CONVERSION`. `TIP` is **opt-in**: it is never in the default set, so it is only returned when you name it here. A tip is a user↔user pUSD transfer that is not a trade-settlement leg; `size` is the amount and `side` carries the direction (`IN` received / `OUT` sent). |
| `condition` | `string \| null` | No | Condition id(s), comma-separated (at most 20 distinct values). `condition_id` / `conditionId` are accepted aliases. |
| `event_id` | `string \| null` | No | Gamma event id(s), comma-separated (at most 20 distinct values); resolves to the events' markets. Mutually exclusive with `condition`. |
| `side` | `string \| null` | No | BUY or SELL. |
| `start` | `number \| null` | No | Window start on `block_timestamp`, epoch seconds (inclusive). Omitted or `0` floors to three years back; pass `start=1` for full history. |
| `end` | `number \| null` | No | Window end, epoch seconds (inclusive); omitted or `0` means now plus one day. |
| `sort_by` | `string \| null` | No | Only `TIMESTAMP` is supported (v2 pages by keyset). |
| `sort_direction` | `string \| null` | No | `ASC` or `DESC` (default). The keyset seeks in the chosen direction; the minted cursor binds it, so pass it consistently when paging. |
| `exclude_deposits_withdrawals` | `boolean \| null` | No | Defaults to `true`, which drops `DEPOSIT` and `WITHDRAWAL` rows from the page, including when `type` names them. Pass `false` to include them. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | The page's rows. |
| `pagination` | `object \| null` | No | — |

**Input**

Aligned with `/v2/positions`: `OPEN` is the superset; it includes still-held redeemable positions; and `REDEEMABLE` narrows to exactly the rows whose `redeemable` flag is `true`. `REDEEMABLE` must be the sole value; the other values may be combined comma-separated and keep per-value equality semantics. |

The minted cursor binds sort + direction along with the `status`/`condition` cohort, so a page-2 request needs only `?user=` and `?cursor=`; restating a filter is allowed but must agree. |
| `sort_direction` | `string \| null` | No | `ASC` or `DESC` (default `DESC`). |
| `updated_after` | `number \| null` | No | Incremental-sync watermark: INCLUSIVE lower bound on `updated_at`, epoch seconds. Without a `status` filter, either watermark serves the sync view; every live row (mirror-complete), not only the held listing; a `status` filter keeps its own row visibility. The window's upper end is always capped by a short stability ceiling (about 90 seconds behind now), so a bound in the future cannot serve rows that may still move. |
| `updated_before` | `number \| null` | No | Incremental-sync watermark: INCLUSIVE upper bound on `updated_at`, epoch seconds; must not precede `updated_after`. See `updated_after` for the sync-view and ceiling semantics. |

### positions.list

`data.positions.list`

List positions for a user or market

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.data.positions.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user` | `string \| null` | No | The wallet to anchor on. At least one of `user`/`condition` is required. |
| `condition` | `string \| null` | No | Condition id(s), comma-separated (at most 20 distinct values). With `user`, narrows that user's positions (all ids honoured). Without `user`, anchors on the market's holders; exactly one id is accepted there, and a multi-id list is rejected rather than silently truncated. |
| `limit` | `number \| null` | No | First-page size. Ignored when `cursor` is supplied (the cursor's size wins). |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor`. It carries the page position, page size, and the status/sort/direction it was minted under. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | One of `OPEN`, `REDEEMABLE`, `REDEEMABLE_LOST`, `MERGEABLE`, or `CLOSED`; defaults to `OPEN`. `REDEEMABLE_LOST` requires `user`, supports every sort but `AVG_PRICE`, and defaults to `CURRENT_VALUE`; it preserves row status `REDEEMABLE`. `MERGEABLE` is `OPEN` narrowed to live complementary pairs (conditions where the wallet holds &gt;= 2 servable-live tokens) and defaults to `TOKENS`; it is user-scoped, so a market-anchored request renders as `OPEN`. `OPEN` is the superset; it includes settled-but-unredeemed winners, which `REDEEMABLE` narrows to. `CLOSED` is exited positions. |
| `event_id` | `string \| null` | No | Event id(s), comma-separated (at most 20 distinct values). User-anchored only. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Case-insensitive market-title substring filter, honoured on every anchor and status. SQL LIKE wildcards (`%`, `_`) keep their usual meaning; empty or whitespace-only is treated as absent; at most 200 characters. NOT carried by the cursor: re-send it on every page of a walk (like `condition` and the `start`/`end` window), or the cohort silently widens. |
| `filter_type` | `string \| null` | No | `CASH` or `TOKENS`; defaults to `TOKENS` (the /v2/trades-homogenized filter pair, replacing the former `size_threshold`). |
| `filter_amount` | `number \| null` | No | The filter floor. `TOKENS`: minimum CURRENT holding in shares (defaults to the 0.1 dust floor; applies to `OPEN`/`REDEEMABLE`; a user's `CLOSED` set is not narrowed by it, and on a market anchor it moves the OPEN/CLOSED boundary). `CASH`: minimum mark-to-market `current_value` in USDC, on top of the token dust floor. Invalid values fall back to the default. |
| `include_archived` | `boolean \| null` | No | Also include positions on archived markets; defaults to `false`. `OPEN`/`REDEEMABLE`/`REDEEMABLE_LOST`/`MERGEABLE` only; combining it with `status=CLOSED` is rejected. Inactive markets remain excluded either way. |
| `sort_by` | `string \| null` | No | One of `CURRENT_VALUE`, `PRICE`, `AVG_PRICE`, `TOKENS`, `UNREALIZED_PNL`, `REALIZED_PNL`, `TOTAL_PNL`, or `TIMESTAMP` (the row's `last_event_at`). `PRICE` ranks by the response's effective `current_price` on every supported anchor and status. `AVG_PRICE` ranks by the response's `avg_price` (the entry price); a user's `CLOSED` and `REDEEMABLE_LOST` positions reject it until they have an indexed path for it. On `REDEEMABLE`, the existing winners-first partition remains ahead of the requested price order. The default follows the status: `CURRENT_VALUE` for `OPEN`/`REDEEMABLE`, `REALIZED_PNL` for `CLOSED`. On a user's `CLOSED` positions, `TOKENS`, `CURRENT_VALUE`, `PRICE` and `UNREALIZED_PNL` describe a holding that no longer exists, so those pages are served in `REALIZED_PNL` order. |
| `start` | `number \| null` | No | Inclusive lower bound on `last_event_at`, epoch seconds; omit or `0` for unbounded (the `/v2/activity` + `/v2/trades` vocabulary). |
| `end` | `number \| null` | No | Inclusive upper bound on `last_event_at`, epoch seconds; omit or `0` for unbounded. A position with no native economics carries no `last_event_at` and is therefore **excluded by any bound**, in either direction; a window asks which positions moved inside it, and a row with no clock has no answer. Unbounded requests still serve those rows. |
| `sort_direction` | `string \| null` | No | `ASC` or `DESC`; defaults to `DESC`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | The page's rows. |
| `pagination` | `object \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
```

### pricesHistory

`data.pricesHistory`

Get a token's price history

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.data.pricesHistory({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `token_id` | `string \| null` | No | Outcome token id (the CLOB asset id the chart is keyed by). Required. `tokenId` is an accepted alias. |
| `start` | `number \| null` | No | Window start, epoch seconds, INCLUSIVE. Alone it means "up to the present", and is capped at 15 days back from now. Pass `end` too when paging: a window that tracks the present keeps growing at the tip, and the 15-day cap is re-checked on every page, so a walk that starts near the cap can outlive it. |
| `end` | `number \| null` | No | Window end, epoch seconds, EXCLUSIVE. Requires `start`; on its own it would ask for every point ever recorded up to `end`. |
| `interval` | `string \| null` | No | Relative window INSTEAD of `start`/`end`: `max`, `all`, `1m`, `1w`, `1d`, `6h`, `1h`, matched case-sensitively. An empty `interval=` is a malformed value, not an absent one. `max`/`all` serve the market's WHOLE life (back to 2022 for the oldest markets) at 12-hour buckets by default; at `bucket_seconds` of 10800 or 43200 the window is unbounded, while finer widths keep a 30-day window. The other intervals take a width sized to their own span when `bucket_seconds` is omitted (`1h`/`6h`/`1d` 60, `1w` 300, `1m` 1800), and each still floors an explicit value: 600 for `max`/`all`/`1m`, 300 for `1w`. |
| `bucket_seconds` | `number \| null` | No | Bucket width in SECONDS (60…86400). `bucketSeconds` is an accepted alias. OMIT it and the server sizes the width to the window: the finest tier grain (60, 300, 1800, 10800, 43200) that keeps the series under ~2,500 points, except that an explicit window wider than 12 hours never defaults to the 60s grain (send `bucket_seconds=60` when you want second-by-minute detail over a longer window), and coarsened further if that grain no longer reaches the window's start. So a window up to 12 hours keeps 1-minute detail, half a day through a week defaults to 300, fifteen days to 1800; interval presets keep their own span-derived defaults (`1d` 60s, `1w` 300, `1m` 1800, and the unbounded `max`/`all` 43200). SEND it and it is served exactly as asked, which for a window older than that resolution's retention means an empty page rather than a silent substitution. An explicit value is also floored per interval: 600 for `max`/`all`/`1m`, 300 for `1w`. |
| `as_of` | `number \| null` | No | Point-in-time read, epoch seconds, INCLUSIVE: the latest observation at or before this instant. Cannot be combined with a window. `asOf` is an accepted alias. |
| `limit` | `number \| null` | No | First-page size; defaults to the cap (10,000). Ignored when `cursor` is supplied (the cursor's size wins). |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | The page's rows. |
| `pagination` | `object \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  price?: number | null,
  resolution_seconds?: number | null,
  timestamp?: number | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="pagination full type">

```ts
{
  has_more?: boolean | null,
  limit?: number | null,
  next_cursor?: string | null | null,
  offset?: number | null
} | null
```

| `event_week` | `string` | No | Filter by event week |

| `exclude_tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to exclude |
| `featured_order` | `string` | No | Order by featured when true (true/false) |
| `recurrence` | `daily \| weekly \| monthly \| annual \| hourly` | No | Recurrence filter |

| `include_markets` | `string` | No | Include each event's markets array (true/false, default true). false skips loading markets, so the response carries the event rows without a markets key |

| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants. Only events that have facets match. |

### events.getByPartner

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.getByPartner({});
```

### events.getBySlug

`gamma.events.getBySlug`

Get event by slug

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.getBySlug({ slug: 'will-bitcoin-hit-100k-in-2026' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | Event slug |
| `include_best_lines` | `string` | No | Include best lines (true/false) |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets each event carries, and each market when markets are included (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors; a market carries only its own, not its event's. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale code |

### events.insights

`gamma.events.insights`

Get event insights

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.insights({ id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Yes | Event ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `context` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### events.list

`gamma.events.list`

Get events

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Event IDs to return |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Event slugs to return |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false/any). Omitted returns open and closed events; 'any' does the same and is accepted for parity with the markets lists |
| `live` | `string` | No | Filter by live flag (true/false) |
| `liquidity_min` | `string` | No | Minimum liquidity |
| `liquidity_max` | `string` | No | Maximum liquidity |
| `volume_min` | `string` | No | Minimum volume |
| `volume_max` | `string` | No | Maximum volume |
| `start_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `start_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to filter by |
| `related_tags` | `string` | No | Include events from related tags (true/false) |
| `tag_match` | `string` | No | Tag match mode |
| `tag_slug` | `string` | No | Filter by tag slug |
| `featured` | `string` | No | Filter by featured flag (true/false) |
| `cyom` | `string` | No | Filter by CYOM flag (true/false) |
| `series_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Series IDs to filter by |
| `series_slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by series slug |
| `game_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Game IDs to filter by |
| `us_id` | `string[] \| null` | No | US event IDs to filter by |
| `event_date` | `string` | No | Filter by event date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `event_week` | `string` | No | Filter by event week |
| `start_time_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start time (RFC3339) |
| `start_time_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start time (RFC3339) |
| `exclude_tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to exclude |
| `featured_order` | `string` | No | Order by featured when true (true/false) |
| `recurrence` | `daily \| weekly \| monthly \| annual \| hourly` | No | Recurrence filter |
| `created_by` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by creator |
| `parent_event_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Parent event IDs to filter by |
| `include_children` | `string` | No | Include the children of the matched parent_event_id or slug (true/false) |
| `top_level` | `string` | No | Return only events without a parent event when true; false has no effect |
| `title_search` | `string` | No | Case-insensitive title search |
| `include_best_lines` | `string` | No | Include best lines (true/false) |
| `include_markets` | `string` | No | Include each event's markets array (true/false, default true). false skips loading markets, so the response carries the event rows without a markets key |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets each event carries, and each market when markets are included (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors; a market carries only its own, not its event's. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale code |
| `partner_slug` | `string` | No | Filter by external partner slug |
| `event_metadata_key` | `string` | No | Filter by event metadata key |
| `event_metadata_value` | `string` | No | Filter by event metadata value |
| `context_requires_regen` | `string` | No | Return only events flagged for context regeneration when true; false has no effect |
| `context_missing` | `string` | No | Return only events with no generated context when true; false has no effect |
| `combo_status` | `string` | No | Filter by combo status (pending/enabled/disabled). Returns events with at least one market in that status, counting markets owned by their child events, and narrows each event's markets array to that status. |
| `version` | `(v1 \| v2)[] \| null` | No | Protocol versions to return (v1 or v2). Repeat the parameter for several. Omitted means the server default (v1 while polymarket-v2 is in its builder integration period) |
| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants. Only events that have facets match. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |
| `market_projection` | `full \| card` | No | Market fields to load. full preserves the default response. card keeps all visible markets with card identity, quotes, lifecycle and selection fields, plus rewards and fee enrichment and market translations, and drops descriptions and resolution, deployment and admin metadata. Event fields, filters, ordering and the 100-row cap are unchanged. Requires include_markets=true (the default). |



**Output:** `object[] \| null`

### events.listKeyset

`gamma.events.listKeyset`

Get events (keyset)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.listKeyset({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Event IDs to return |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Event slugs to return |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false/any). Omitted returns open and closed events; 'any' does the same and is accepted for parity with the markets lists |
| `live` | `string` | No | Filter by live flag (true/false) |
| `liquidity_min` | `string` | No | Minimum liquidity |
| `liquidity_max` | `string` | No | Maximum liquidity |
| `volume_min` | `string` | No | Minimum volume |
| `volume_max` | `string` | No | Maximum volume |
| `start_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `start_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to filter by |
| `related_tags` | `string` | No | Include events from related tags (true/false) |
| `tag_match` | `string` | No | Tag match mode |
| `tag_slug` | `string` | No | Filter by tag slug |
| `featured` | `string` | No | Filter by featured flag (true/false) |
| `cyom` | `string` | No | Filter by CYOM flag (true/false) |
| `series_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Series IDs to filter by |
| `series_slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by series slug |
| `game_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Game IDs to filter by |
| `us_id` | `string[] \| null` | No | US event IDs to filter by |
| `event_date` | `string` | No | Filter by event date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `event_week` | `string` | No | Filter by event week |
| `start_time_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start time (RFC3339) |
| `start_time_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start time (RFC3339) |
| `exclude_tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to exclude |
| `featured_order` | `string` | No | Order by featured when true (true/false) |
| `recurrence` | `daily \| weekly \| monthly \| annual \| hourly` | No | Recurrence filter |
| `created_by` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by creator |
| `parent_event_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Parent event IDs to filter by |
| `include_children` | `string` | No | Include the children of the matched parent_event_id or slug (true/false) |
| `top_level` | `string` | No | Return only events without a parent event when true; false has no effect |
| `title_search` | `string` | No | Case-insensitive title search |
| `include_best_lines` | `string` | No | Include best lines (true/false) |
| `include_markets` | `string` | No | Include each event's markets array (true/false, default true). false skips loading markets, so the response carries the event rows without a markets key |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets each event carries, and each market when markets are included (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors; a market carries only its own, not its event's. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale code |
| `partner_slug` | `string` | No | Filter by external partner slug |
| `event_metadata_key` | `string` | No | Filter by event metadata key |
| `event_metadata_value` | `string` | No | Filter by event metadata value |
| `context_requires_regen` | `string` | No | Return only events flagged for context regeneration when true; false has no effect |
| `context_missing` | `string` | No | Return only events with no generated context when true; false has no effect |
| `combo_status` | `string` | No | Filter by combo status (pending/enabled/disabled). Returns events with at least one market in that status, counting markets owned by their child events, and narrows each event's markets array to that status. |
| `version` | `(v1 \| v2)[] \| null` | No | Protocol versions to return (v1 or v2). Repeat the parameter for several. Omitted means the server default (v1 while polymarket-v2 is in its builder integration period) |
| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants. Only events that have facets match. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |
| `market_projection` | `full \| status \| card` | No | Market fields to load. full preserves the default response. status keeps every visible market in the same order, with only id, conditionId, marketMakerAddress, feeType, sportsMarketType, closed, gameStartTime, tradingEligible and resolutionMechanism; skips market enrichment and translation. Event fields, filters and ordering are unchanged. status allows up to 500 candidates and returns event_cursors for resuming after each row; full keeps its 100-row cap. card keeps all visible markets with card identity, quotes, lifecycle and selection fields, plus rewards and fee enrichment and market translations; its cap is 100 and it omits event_cursors. Requires include_markets=true (the default). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `event_cursors` | `string[] \| null \| null` | No | Status projection only: one signed continuation cursor per event, in event order. Clients can resume after a partially consumed batch. |
| `events` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `next_cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### events.listPaginated

`gamma.events.listPaginated`

Get events (paginated)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.listPaginated({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Event IDs to return |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Event slugs to return |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false/any). Omitted returns open and closed events; 'any' does the same and is accepted for parity with the markets lists |
| `live` | `string` | No | Filter by live flag (true/false) |
| `liquidity_min` | `string` | No | Minimum liquidity |
| `liquidity_max` | `string` | No | Maximum liquidity |
| `volume_min` | `string` | No | Minimum volume |
| `volume_max` | `string` | No | Maximum volume |
| `start_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `start_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to filter by |
| `related_tags` | `string` | No | Include events from related tags (true/false) |
| `tag_match` | `string` | No | Tag match mode |
| `tag_slug` | `string` | No | Filter by tag slug |
| `featured` | `string` | No | Filter by featured flag (true/false) |
| `cyom` | `string` | No | Filter by CYOM flag (true/false) |
| `series_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Series IDs to filter by |
| `series_slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by series slug |
| `game_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Game IDs to filter by |
| `us_id` | `string[] \| null` | No | US event IDs to filter by |
| `event_date` | `string` | No | Filter by event date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `event_week` | `string` | No | Filter by event week |
| `start_time_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start time (RFC3339) |
| `start_time_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start time (RFC3339) |
| `exclude_tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to exclude |
| `featured_order` | `string` | No | Order by featured when true (true/false) |
| `recurrence` | `daily \| weekly \| monthly \| annual \| hourly` | No | Recurrence filter |
| `created_by` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by creator |
| `parent_event_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Parent event IDs to filter by |
| `include_children` | `string` | No | Include the children of the matched parent_event_id or slug (true/false) |
| `top_level` | `string` | No | Return only events without a parent event when true; false has no effect |
| `title_search` | `string` | No | Case-insensitive title search |
| `include_best_lines` | `string` | No | Include best lines (true/false) |
| `include_markets` | `string` | No | Include each event's markets array (true/false, default true). false skips loading markets, so the response carries the event rows without a markets key |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets each event carries, and each market when markets are included (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors; a market carries only its own, not its event's. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale code |
| `partner_slug` | `string` | No | Filter by external partner slug |
| `event_metadata_key` | `string` | No | Filter by event metadata key |
| `event_metadata_value` | `string` | No | Filter by event metadata value |
| `context_requires_regen` | `string` | No | Return only events flagged for context regeneration when true; false has no effect |
| `context_missing` | `string` | No | Return only events with no generated context when true; false has no effect |
| `combo_status` | `string` | No | Filter by combo status (pending/enabled/disabled). Returns events with at least one market in that status, counting markets owned by their child events, and narrows each event's markets array to that status. |
| `version` | `(v1 \| v2)[] \| null` | No | Protocol versions to return (v1 or v2). Repeat the parameter for several. Omitted means the server default (v1 while polymarket-v2 is in its builder integration period) |
| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants. Only events that have facets match. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `pagination` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### events.similar

`gamma.events.similar`

Get similar events

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.similar({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | No | Event ID. Fastest path: skips the Typesense reference lookup. |
| `event_title` | `string` | No | Free-text event title to find a reference event in Typesense. |
| `event_slug` | `string` | No | Event slug. Validated as a slug when provided, looked up in PG. |
| `market_title` | `string` | No | Free-text market title to find a reference event in Typesense. |
| `market_slug` | `string` | No | Market slug. Validated as a slug when provided; the parent event is used as the reference. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned. Capped at 50. |
| `closed` | `true \| false` | No | Optional. When 'true' returns only resolved events; when 'false' returns only open events. When omitted, both are returned. Always combined with the unconditional active=true filter. |
| `include_markets` | `string` | No | Load each event's markets (true/false). Off by default: the response is the slim event list. |
| `markets_limit` | `number` | No | With include_markets=true, keep only the N most likely markets per event: open markets first, then by first outcome price descending. 0 (default) keeps every market. |
| `search_timeout_ms` | `number` | No | Optional wait budget for vector-search candidates in milliseconds (100 to 5000). Expiry uses the popular-events fallback without cancelling the underlying search, which has a server-owned deadline of at most 5 seconds. When omitted, the configured search deadline applies. |



**Output:** `object[] \| null`

### events.sportResults

`gamma.events.sportResults`

Get sport event results

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.events.sportResults({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Event IDs |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Event slugs |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false) |
| `series_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Series IDs |
| `game_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Game IDs |
| `event_date` | `string` | No | Filter by event date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `event_week` | `string` | No | Filter by event week |
| `start_time_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start time (RFC3339) |
| `start_time_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start time (RFC3339) |
| `version` | `(v1 \| v2)[] \| null` | No | Protocol versions to return (v1 or v2). Omitted means the server default |
| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants. Only events that have facets match. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |



**Output:** `object[] \| null`

<AccordionGroup>

### markets.get

`gamma.markets.get`

Get market by ID

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.markets.get({ id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| `id` | `number` | Yes | Market ID |
| `include_tag` | `string` | No | Include tag data (true/false) |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets assigned to each market (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale used to localize returned content |

### markets.getBySlug

`gamma.markets.getBySlug`

Get market by slug

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.markets.getBySlug({ slug: 'will-bitcoin-hit-100k-in-2026' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | Market slug |
| `include_tag` | `string` | No | Include tag data (true/false) |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets assigned to each market (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale used to localize returned content |



**Output**

### markets.information

`gamma.markets.information`

Get markets information

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.markets.information({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets assigned to each market (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors. |

---

### markets.list

`gamma.markets.list`

Get markets

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.markets.list({
	closed: 'false',
	limit: 5,
	order: 'volume24hr',
	ascending: false,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Market IDs to return |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Market slugs to return |
| `archived` | `string` | No | Filter by archived flag (true/false) |
| `active` | `string` | No | Filter by active flag (true/false) |
| `decimalized` | `string` | No | Filter by decimalized flag (true/false) |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false/any). Defaults to false on the public lists when omitted. 'any' returns open and closed markets together and requires at least one of id, slug, clob_token_ids, position_ids, condition_ids, request_ids, onchain_event_ids, or question_ids |
| `clob_token_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | CLOB token IDs to return |
| `position_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | Position IDs to return |
| `condition_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | Condition IDs to return |
| `request_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | V2 oracle request IDs to return (conditionId for binary/incremental neg-risk, onchainEventId for atomic neg-risk) |
| `onchain_event_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | V2 on-chain event IDs to return (all markets of each on-chain event) |
| `market_maker_address` | `string[] \| null` | No | Market maker addresses to return |
| `liquidity_num_min` | `string` | No | Minimum liquidity |
| `liquidity_num_max` | `string` | No | Maximum liquidity |
| `volume_num_min` | `string` | No | Minimum volume |
| `volume_num_max` | `string` | No | Maximum volume |
| `start_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `start_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to filter by |
| `related_tags` | `string` | No | Include markets from related tags (true/false) |
| `tag_match` | `string` | No | Tag match mode |
| `cyom` | `string` | No | Filter by CYOM flag (true/false) |
| `rfq_enabled` | `string` | No | Filter by RFQ-enabled flag (true/false) |
| `combo_status` | `string` | No | Filter by combo status (pending/enabled/disabled) |
| `uma_resolution_status` | `string` | No | Filter by UMA resolution status |
| `resolution_status` | `inactive \| active \| resolved` | No | Filter by resolution status (inactive/active/resolved). v2 markets only — v1 markets carry no resolution_status and use uma_resolution_status instead |
| `version` | `(v1 \| v2)[] \| null` | No | Protocol versions to return (v1 or v2). Repeat the parameter for several. Omitted means the server default on public lists (v1 while polymarket-v2 is in its builder integration period) |
| `game_id` | `string` | No | Filter by game ID |
| `sports_market_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by sports market types |
| `rewards_min_size` | `string` | No | Filter by minimum rewards size |
| `question_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | Question IDs to return |
| `include_tag` | `string` | No | Include tag data (true/false) |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets assigned to each market (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale used to localize returned content |
| `market_metadata_key` | `string` | No | Filter by market metadata key |
| `market_metadata_value` | `string` | No | Filter by market metadata value |
| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants; a market matches only its own facets, not its event's. Only markets that have facets match. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |



**Output:** `object[] \| null`

### markets.listAbridged

### markets.listAbridgedKeyset

`gamma.markets.listAbridgedKeyset`

Get abridged markets with keyset pagination

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.markets.listAbridgedKeyset({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets assigned to each market (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors. |
| `clobTokenIds` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |
| `closed` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `comboStatus` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `conditionIds` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cyom` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `endDateMax` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `endDateMin` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `facets` | `string \| null` | No | AIP-160 expression over facet slugs, as the facets query parameter on GET /markets |
| `gameId` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | — |
| `includeTags` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `liquidityNumMax` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `liquidityNumMin` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `marketMakerAddress` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |

| `rfqEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |
| `sportsMarketTypes` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |
| `startDateMax` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### markets.listKeyset

`gamma.markets.listKeyset`

Get markets (keyset)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.markets.listKeyset({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Market IDs to return |
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Market slugs to return |
| `archived` | `string` | No | Filter by archived flag (true/false) |
| `active` | `string` | No | Filter by active flag (true/false) |
| `decimalized` | `string` | No | Filter by decimalized flag (true/false) |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false/any). Defaults to false on the public lists when omitted. 'any' returns open and closed markets together and requires at least one of id, slug, clob_token_ids, position_ids, condition_ids, request_ids, onchain_event_ids, or question_ids |
| `clob_token_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | CLOB token IDs to return |
| `position_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | Position IDs to return |
| `condition_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | Condition IDs to return |
| `request_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | V2 oracle request IDs to return (conditionId for binary/incremental neg-risk, onchainEventId for atomic neg-risk) |
| `onchain_event_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | V2 on-chain event IDs to return (all markets of each on-chain event) |
| `market_maker_address` | `string[] \| null` | No | Market maker addresses to return |
| `liquidity_num_min` | `string` | No | Minimum liquidity |
| `liquidity_num_max` | `string` | No | Maximum liquidity |
| `volume_num_min` | `string` | No | Minimum volume |
| `volume_num_max` | `string` | No | Maximum volume |
| `start_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `start_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_min` | `string` | No | Minimum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date_max` | `string` | No | Maximum end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `tag_id` | `number[] \| null` | No | Tag IDs to filter by |
| `related_tags` | `string` | No | Include markets from related tags (true/false) |
| `tag_match` | `string` | No | Tag match mode |
| `cyom` | `string` | No | Filter by CYOM flag (true/false) |
| `rfq_enabled` | `string` | No | Filter by RFQ-enabled flag (true/false) |
| `combo_status` | `string` | No | Filter by combo status (pending/enabled/disabled) |
| `uma_resolution_status` | `string` | No | Filter by UMA resolution status |
| `resolution_status` | `inactive \| active \| resolved` | No | Filter by resolution status (inactive/active/resolved). v2 markets only — v1 markets carry no resolution_status and use uma_resolution_status instead |
| `version` | `(v1 \| v2)[] \| null` | No | Protocol versions to return (v1 or v2). Repeat the parameter for several. Omitted means the server default on public lists (v1 while polymarket-v2 is in its builder integration period) |
| `game_id` | `string` | No | Filter by game ID |
| `sports_market_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | Filter by sports market types |
| `rewards_min_size` | `string` | No | Filter by minimum rewards size |
| `question_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | Question IDs to return |
| `include_tag` | `string` | No | Include tag data (true/false) |
| `include_facets` | `string` | No | Include the facets assigned to each market (true/false). Facets are the assigned ones plus their ancestors. |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale used to localize returned content |
| `market_metadata_key` | `string` | No | Filter by market metadata key |
| `market_metadata_value` | `string` | No | Filter by market metadata value |
| `facets` | `string` | No | AIP-160 filter over facet slugs, e.g. politics AND (nba OR wnba) -united-states. AND, OR, NOT or -, a space for AND, and one level of parentheses; NOT binds tightest, then AND, then OR; at most 10 facets. A facet also matches its descendants; a market matches only its own facets, not its event's. Only markets that have facets match. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `markets` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `next_cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### series.list

`gamma.series.list`

Get series

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.series.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Series slugs to return |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false). Defaults to false when omitted. |
| `recurrence` | `daily \| weekly \| monthly \| annual \| hourly` | No | Filter by recurrence: daily, weekly, monthly, annual, or hourly |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale used to localize returned content |
| `exclude_events` | `string` | No | Exclude embedded events when true (true/false) |
| `limit` | `string` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `string` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `string` | No | Sort ascending when true. Defaults to true when order is supplied. |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |



**Output:** `object[] \| null`

---

### series.listKeyset

`gamma.series.listKeyset`

Get series (keyset)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.series.listKeyset({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string[] \| null` | No | Series slugs to return |
| `closed` | `string` | No | Filter by closed flag (true/false). Defaults to false when omitted. |
| `recurrence` | `daily \| weekly \| monthly \| annual \| hourly` | No | Filter by recurrence: daily, weekly, monthly, annual, or hourly |
| `locale` | `string` | No | Locale used to localize returned content |
| `exclude_events` | `string` | No | Exclude embedded events when true (true/false) |
| `limit` | `string` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `string` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `string` | No | Sort ascending when true. Defaults to true when order is supplied. |
| `after_cursor` | `string` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor from a previous response |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `next_cursor` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque cursor to pass as after_cursor when requesting the next page. Absent on the last page. |
| `series` | `object[] \| null` | No | Series returned for the current page. |

### series.summary

`gamma.series.summary`

Get series summary by ID

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.series.summary({ id: '12' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Series ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `earliest_open_date` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### tournaments.list

`gamma.tournaments.list`

Get tournaments

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.tournaments.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max results returned |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Number of results to skip |
| `order` | `string` | No | Comma-separated field names to sort by |
| `ascending` | `boolean` | No | Sort ascending when true (default true) |



**Output:** `object[] \| null`

### walletType

`gamma.walletType`

Get wallet type

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.gamma.walletType({ address: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839', signer: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `address` | `string` | Yes | Wallet address |
| `signer` | `string` | Yes | Signer address |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `$schema` | `string \| null` | No | A URL to the JSON Schema for this object. |
| `type` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `typeName` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### account.applyReferral

`perps.account.applyReferral`

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.perps.account.applyReferral({ code: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `code` | `string` | Yes | Referral or invite code |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | — |

`perps.public.fills`

| `end_timestamp` | `number` | No | End timestamp in milliseconds |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | Pagination cursor. Pass the opaque `cursor` returned by the previous page to fetch the next page. Paging follows the `sort` direction (strictly older fills when `sort=desc`, strictly newer when `sort=asc`). | `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | Opaque keyset pagination cursor for the next page of fills. Present while `more` is true; pass it as `cursor` on the next request, keeping the other parameters the same across pages. |

| `nonce` | `string` | Yes | Transaction nonce |
| `signature` | `string` | Yes | Transaction signature (0x-prefixed hex string) |
| `signatureParams` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `type` | `SAFE \| PROXY` | Yes | Transaction type |

### trades.prepare

`rfq.trades.prepare`

Build both orders to sign

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.rfq.trades.prepare({
	operation: 'split',
	price: 'example',
	shares: '1000000',
	parties: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `marketId` | `string` | No | Required unless `marketSource` is `combo`. |
| `marketSource` | `gamma \| bespoke \| combo` | No | `gamma` for a Polymarket market id, `bespoke` for a bespoke market, `combo` for a market defined by its `legs`. |
| `legs` | `object[]` | No | The combo's legs, for `marketSource` `combo` only. |
| `combination` | `and` | No | The combo operator. Omitted means `and`. |
| `operation` | `split \| merge \| trade` | Yes | `split`: both sides buy, one YES and one NO. `merge`: both sides sell, one YES and one NO. `trade`: one side buys an outcome token from the other. |
| `token` | `yes \| no` | No | The outcome token that changes hands, for `trade` only. |
| `price` | `string` | Yes | The agreed price in (0, 1). The YES price for a split or merge, the traded token's price for a trade. |
| `shares` | `string` | Yes | A base-10 integer in 6-decimal units. |
| `parties` | `object` | Yes | Keyed `yes` and `no` for a split or merge, `buyer` and `seller` for a trade. |
| `priceTolerance` | `string` | No | Tightens the price band to this fraction of the mark, e.g. `0.05` for ±5%. Wider than the default is refused. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="legs full type">

```ts
{
  marketId: string,
  outcome: yes | no
}[]
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="parties full type">

```ts
Record<string, {
  maker: string,
  signer?: string,
  signatureType: number,
  role?: maker | taker
}>
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `orders` | `object \| null` | No | Keyed like the request's `parties`. |
| `fees` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | The fee each side will be charged, keyed like `orders`. |
| `expiresAt` | `string \| null` | No | After this, a submission of these orders is refused as stale. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="orders full type">

```ts
Record<string, {
  order?: {
    salt?: string | null,
    maker?: string | null,
    signer?: string | null,
    tokenId?: string | null,
    makerAmount?: string | null,
    takerAmount?: string | null,
    side?: number | null,
    signatureType?: number | null,
    timestamp?: string | null,
    metadata?: string | null,
    builder?: string | null
  } | null,
  typedData?: {
  } | null,
  role?: string | null,
  digest?: string | null,
  signatureSuffix?: string | null
}> | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### trades.submit

`rfq.trades.submit`

Submit a signed RFQ trade

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.polymarket.api.rfq.trades.submit({
	orders: [{
		salt: '1000000',
		maker: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839',
		signer: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839',
		tokenId: '1000000',
		makerAmount: '1000000',
		takerAmount: '1000000',
		side: 0,
		signatureType: 1,
		timestamp: 'example',
		metadata: 'example',
		builder: 'example',
		signature: 'example',
	}, {
		salt: '1000000',
		maker: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839',
		signer: '0x56687bf447db6ffa42ffe2204a05edaa20f55839',
		tokenId: '1000000',
		makerAmount: '1000000',
		takerAmount: '1000000',
		side: 0,
		signatureType: 1,
		timestamp: 'example',
		metadata: 'example',
		builder: 'example',
		signature: 'example',
	}],
	idempotencyKey: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `marketId` | `string` | No | Required unless `marketSource` is `combo`. |
| `marketSource` | `gamma \| bespoke \| combo` | No | `gamma` for a Polymarket market id, `bespoke` for a bespoke market, `combo` for a market defined by its `legs`. |
| `legs` | `object[]` | No | — |
| `combination` | `and` | No | The combo operator. Omitted means `and`. |
| `orders` | `object[]` | Yes | Both signed orders, in any order. |
| `idempotencyKey` | `string` | Yes | The partner's own reference for the trade. |
| `priceTolerance` | `string` | No | As on `PrepareRequest`. |
| `takerFeeAmount` | `0` | No | Not an input. Omit it; anything but `0` is rejected with `fee_not_accepted`. |
| `makerFeeAmount` | `0` | No | Not an input. Omit it; anything but `0` is rejected with `fee_not_accepted`. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="legs full type">

```ts
{
  marketId: string,
  outcome: yes | no
}[]
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="orders full type">

```ts
{
  salt: string,
  maker: string,
  signer: string,
  tokenId: string,
  makerAmount: string,
  takerAmount: string,
  side: 0 | 1,
  signatureType: number,
  timestamp: string,
  metadata: string,
  builder: string,
  signature: string,
  role?: maker | taker
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tradeId` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | `PENDING` until the trade lands on-chain (`FILLED`) or is refused or fails (`REJECTED`). |
| `fees` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | The fee each side is charged, keyed like the trade's parties. |
| `transactionHash` | `string \| null` | No | Set once the trade has executed, so only on a replay. |
| `createdAt` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `combo` | `object \| null` | No | A combo's on-chain identity. Present on combo trades only. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="combo full type">

```ts
{
  conditionId?: string | null,
  tokenIdYes?: string | null,
  tokenIdNo?: string | null,
  legs?: {
    marketId?: string | null,
    outcome?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
